risk_if_not_implemented: Without Prohibit Portable Storage Devices Use Without Owner, mobile and portable devices may expose organizational data through loss, theft, insecure configuration or unauthorized use. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Least Functionality
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services.
compensating_control_1.justification: Least Functionality (CFG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Prohibit Use Without Owner (DCH-20.1) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Digital Media Use Restrictions
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the use of types of digital media on systems or system components.
compensating_control_2.justification: Digital Media Use Restrictions (DCH-19) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Prohibit Use Without Owner (DCH-20.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
